We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Office Manager who will ensure smooth office operations. The ideal candidate will manage administrative tasks, coordinate logistics, and maintain efficient office functions to facilitate project execution.

The candidate in mind will be expected to perform the following duties that include but are not limited to:

Your new company     A great opportunity has come to fruition to join a developer builder in Hervey Bay, well known for building a quality products. They have a solid pipeline of work and with approvals for further projects in Hervey Bay, providing long-term work in Hervey Bay.  We also need a Site Manager for a well-regarded commercial builder, on a school project.    Your new role     You will be joining them on a Multi-Story Unit Development, complemented by a full-site team. You will work closely with the Project Manager to ensure everything runs smoothly. You will take overall responsibility for quality, safety and coordinating all trades in delivering this fully documented D&C project. Scheduling and fortnightly programming along with maintaining site diaries and quality records using Ritek will all play a part in this role.    What you'll need to succeed     
 To be considered, you must have experience as a Site Manager on medium-rise unit developments, ideally with projects that are $10M+ with 6 levels or more, or Govt Institutional projects. A current QBCC Builder's Supervisors Licence is essential, while knowledge of local trades and officials would be advantageous. If you're a Foreman ready for the next step-up and/or have worked on other commercial projects, please apply. This is a site with constricted lifting areas, and experience as a Structures Foreman with Ritek & tower cranes will be highly regarded. 
   
   Only candidates based in Australia will be considered and preferably currently based (or soon to be) in Hervey Bay.   
   
  What you'll get in return     Salary will be commensurate with experience, while a range between $160k to $200k base is a good indicator, possibly more for the right candidate. This is a permanent role, joining a reputable builder, with long-term local work.    What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, please click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your resume. For any queries, feel free to contact Yasmin Mitchell | Yasmin.Mitchell@hays.com.au    Please  click here  to apply.

ABOUT US
As Australia's leading environmentally focused service business, delivering on modern thinking and action to prevent, stop and reverse environmental damage, our core focus is to create safe and sustainable environments within communities. Behind our success is a very talented and inclusive team of diverse individuals that you too could join, bringing your knowledge, experience, skills, and attributes that will only make the foundation of our company, our people, even stronger.

Through our values of People First, Collaboration, Creative Thinking and Customer Focus, we work to help our people achieve our goals and enjoy their work. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and are committed to creating an equitable , diverse and inclusive work environment for all. We recognise that diversity strengthens us and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply, including women and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are seeking an Operator / Leading Hand to join our projects team.

You will be responsible for supporting the delivery of site works on unique and exciting projects across Darwin and the broader NT.

As an Operator /  Leading Hand, you will be responsible for the following:
Supervision and operation of plant, labour, and subcontractors.
Supporting Supervisors in planning and co-ordination of site work.
Enforcing and demonstrating safe work practices in all site-related works.
Ensuring that personnel are adequately trained and supported.
Assist the Project Manager and Project Engineers with site operations.

ABOUT YOU
You will be an experienced Operator / Leading Hand who has a background in either supervision, or Plant Operations on civil or environmental remediation projects. 

You will have:
5+ years experience working on Civil or Remediation projects.
Earthworks experience.
Demonstrated ability to take a hands-on approach on site.
Asbestos Removal tickets, advantageous but not essential.
Plant Operation tickets.
Drivers licence.
Australian Citizenship. 

WHAT WE GIVE YOU IN RETURN
Rewarding and important work that makes a difference to the community and the environment.

We prioritise your Health and Wellbeing:
Four paid annual Wellbeing Days, we give you additional time off to do the things that you love with the people you love.
Employee assistance program, a free counselling and lifestyle service for you and your family.

We care about your future with us:
Propel your career: Unlock your potential with tailored and ongoing professional development and internal job opportunities to ensure you stay ahead in your field.

We offer competitive rewards and benefits:
Rewarding Referrals: Your recommendations matter to us. Our generous employee referral incentive program is instrumental in building a team of like-minded individuals that share our company values.
Celebrating our Champions: We acknowledge and celebrate our employees' achievements in supporting our company principles through the monthly and annual Enviro Achiever awards.?
Enhancing your Lifestyle: We offer paid primary and secondary carer leave, novated leases, flexible work arrangements and purchased leave.

We acknowledges the Traditional Owners of the land where we work and live. We pay our respects to Elders past, present and emerging. We are committed to strengthening relationships between Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and non-Indigenous peoples for the benefit of all Australians.

Ashley Furniture is seeking an experienced Retail and Service Manager to lead their showroom in Griffith, NSW.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Reports to: Director and Business Owner

Supervises: Store Managers, Assistant Managers, Sales Staff, Customer Service Staff, Administrative Staff, Warehouse Personnel and other operational employees as required.

Position Summary:
The Retail and Service Manager is responsible for planning, organising, directing, controlling and coordinating the operations of retail and service establishments to ensure the achievement of business objectives, profitability targets and customer service standards. The role oversees staff management, financial performance, inventory control, sales growth, customer engagement, operational compliance and
continuous business improvement.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Business Operations Management
• Plan, organise, direct and coordinate the day-to-day operations of retail and service establishments.
• Develop and implement operational strategies, policies and procedures to achieve organisational objectives.
• Monitor business performance and implement initiatives to improve efficiency, productivity and profitability.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, industry regulations and workplace health and safety requirements.
• Coordinate business activities to ensure effective service delivery and operational continuity. 

Sales and Customer Service Management
• Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
• Monitor sales performance and key performance indicators and take corrective action where required.
• Establish and maintain high standards of customer service and customer satisfaction.
• Manage customer enquiries, complaints and escalated issues in a professional and timely manner.
• Develop customer engagement and retention initiatives to strengthen customer relationships and business growth.

 Staff Leadership and Human Resource Management
• Recruit, train, supervise and develop employees to meet operational and customer service requirements.
• Allocate work responsibilities and manage staff rosters and resource requirements.

Xtremepush is an Omnichannel Customer Engagement Platform powered by a built-in CDP. It enables leading brands to leverage real-time data, AI and gamification to deliver highly personalised, lifecycle-specific customer journeys that drive conversions at scale. All with one unified solution.
Headquartered in Dublin, and with offices in London, New York, and São Paulo, the company helps operators all around the world understand their customers and improve player experiences world-wide.

Role Purpose 

The Sales and Marketing Manager (APAC) is responsible for planning, directing, and coordinating regional sales and marketing activities to drive revenue growth, customer retention, and brand expansion. The role combines strategic leadership with operational execution, overseeing account management functions, regional go-to-market strategies, and cross-functional collaboration to maximise organisational performance and market presence. 
Key Responsibilities 
1. Sales & Marketing Strategy 
? Direct the development and execution of regional sales strategies, setting targets to maximise revenue, client growth, and customer loyalty. 
? Lead the creation and implementation of marketing and go-to-market strategies to promote the organisation’s products and services across APAC. 
? Drive initiatives to strengthen brand positioning, customer engagement, and long-term brand loyalty in the region. 
? Develop and implement strategies to enhance the organisation’s reputation with clients and stakeholders. 
2. Leadership & Team Management 
? Lead, manage, and grow a team of Account Managers across the APAC region. 
? Provide coaching, mentorship, and performance management to ensure high levels of engagement and productivity. 
? Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and development planning. 
? Lead recruitment and onboarding of new team members, including Account Managers and supporting roles. 
? Establish a high-performing regional team aligned with company values and objectives. 
3. Sales Pipeline & Revenue Management 
? Oversee and control the regional sales and account management pipeline to ensure alignment with revenue targets 
? Manage upsell, renewal, and retention strategies to achieve growth and minimise churn. 
? Analyse pipeline performance, identify risks and opportunities, and implement corrective actions. 
? Own forecasting accuracy and provide regular reporting and insights to senior leadership. 
4. Strategic Planning & Regional Expansion 
? Establish and lead the APAC regional function, defining how products and services are sold, managed, and scaled. 
? Contribute to pricing and packaging strategies tailored to regional market conditions. 
? Identify market trends, competitive insights, and customer feedback to inform strategic decisions. 
? Support expansion into new geographies across Asia and Oceania. 
5. Client Relationship & Account Oversight 
? Maintain senior-level relationships with key clients across the region. 
? Ensure high renewal rates, strong customer satisfaction, and delivery of value through account management practices. 
? Act as the primary escalation point for complex client issues across account management, onboarding, and support. 
? Attend strategic conferences and events within the region to promote the business and enforce strong client relations through face to face meetings 
? Oversee delivery quality and resource allocation for new and existing clients. 
6. Systems, Reporting & Process Optimisation 
? Direct the effective use of CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot) to ensure accurate data management, reporting, and automation. 
? Implement best practices for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and customer engagement. 
? Collaborate with finance and operations to align sales forecasts with budgets and strategic plans. 
7. Cross-functional Collaboration 
? Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to ensure a unified customer approach. 
? Act as the regional liaison to ensure alignment of processes, communication, and execution. 
? Support new business initiatives, including RFP participation and market development activities. 
8. Operational & Support Oversight 
? Oversee service delivery standards, including SLAs, response times, and customer satisfaction metrics. 
? Support interim operational needs (e.g., customer support or onboarding) during regional scaling. 
? Ensure all business functions operate effectively within the APAC region. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

Revenue & Growth 
? Achievement of upsell and revenue growth targets 
? High renewal rates and minimal customer churn 
Pipeline & Forecasting 
? Accuracy of sales forecasts 
? Maintenance of a healthy and progressing sales pipeline 
Customer Success 
? Strong client satisfaction and retention 
? Delivery of regular business reviews and strategic account engagement 
Team Performance 
? Development and retention of a high-performing team 
? Successful hiring and scaling of regional headcount 
Regional Leadership 
? Successful establishment and growth of APAC operations 
? Effective cross-functional alignment and operational delivery 

Skills & Experience 

? Minimum 3 years of relevant experience and Bachelor degrees in relevant field 
? Proven experience in sales and/or account management leadership roles 
? Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities in sales and marketing 
? Experience managing regional or international markets (APAC preferred) 
? Demonstrated ability to lead teams, drive performance, and scale operations 
? Strong analytical, forecasting, and CRM management skills 
? Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

Position Description: Bilco Group is seeking a qualified Full time wall and floor tiler to work on residential and commercial projects.
Key Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Review and interpret building plans, drawings and specifications, and accurately measure, mark out and set up work areas before work begins.
•	Prepare wall and floor substrates by stripping away old grout, adhesive and other unsuitable materials, rectifying surface defects, and ensuring all surfaces are clean, sound and level ready for tile installation.
•	Apply waterproofing membranes and surface treatments where required.
•	Mix and spread adhesives, cement-based mortars and screeds onto prepared surfaces using the correct methods and techniques.
•	Lay and position tiles with precision, maintaining correct alignment, uniform spacing and a level finish.
•	Cut, shape and fit ceramic, porcelain, terrazzo, glass mosaic and natural stone tiles using hand and power tools, working neatly around edges, corners, fixtures, fittings and pipework.
•	Grout tile joints, then clean and polish completed surfaces to achieve the required finish.
•	Fit tile strips and trim sections to form decorative patterns and produce clean, professional edge detailing.
•	Check finished work against plans, quality expectations and applicable building codes to confirm compliance.
•	Keep the work site clean, safe and well organised at all times.
•	Communicate and coordinate effectively with site supervisors, project managers and other trades on site.

•	Certificate III in Wall and Floor Tiling (or equivalent), or at least 3 years' full time relevant experience in lieu of the qualification.

About Us

Black Elk Espresso is a busy and well-established café located in Carnes Hill, known for its quality food, premium coffee and exceptional customer service. We pride ourselves on providing a welcoming atmosphere, efficient service and a consistently high standard of hospitality for our customers.

Our café serves a diverse clientele, including local residents, families and professionals, and operates in a fast-paced environment throughout weekdays and weekends. We are committed to maintaining excellent operational standards while fostering a positive and supportive workplace for our team.

Role

Black Elk Espresso is seeking an experienced and motivated Venue Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of the venue. The position involves managing daily business operations, supervising staff, monitoring financial performance, maintaining exceptional customer service standards, and ensuring the efficient and profitable operation of the café.

The Venue Manager will oversee staffing, budgeting, stock control, supplier relationships and venue operations while ensuring compliance with food safety, workplace health and safety, and licensing requirements. Applicants must possess strong leadership, organisational and communication skills, together with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

Oversee the day-to-day operations of the venue to ensure efficient service and a high standard of customer satisfaction.
Manage, recruit, train, supervise and mentor front and back-of-house staff, ensuring appropriate staffing levels and performance standards.
Prepare and manage staff rosters, monitor labour costs and allocate duties to maximise operational efficiency.
Monitor venue performance, sales, operating costs and budgets, and implement strategies to improve profitability and business performance.
Manage stock ordering, inventory levels and supplier relationships to ensure the timely supply of goods and minimise wastage.
Ensure exceptional customer service by responding to customer enquiries, resolving complaints and maintaining positive customer relationships.
Develop, implement and monitor operational policies and procedures to maintain consistent service standards.
Ensure compliance with food safety legislation, workplace health and safety requirements, licensing obligations and company policies.
Monitor the presentation, cleanliness and maintenance of the venue to ensure a safe and welcoming environment for customers and staff.
Liaise with senior management regarding business performance, staffing requirements, promotional activities and operational improvements.
Analyse financial and operational reports and implement initiatives to improve efficiency, productivity and customer experience.
Coordinate special events, promotions and marketing initiatives to increase customer engagement and venue performance.

Skills and Qualifications

AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma (OSCA Skill Level 2).
At least 3 years of relevant work experience.
Demonstrated experience managing a café, restaurant or hospitality venue.
Strong leadership, organisational and communication skills.
Ability to manage staff, coordinate daily operations and maintain high customer service standards in a fast-paced hospitality environment.
Sound understanding of budgeting, stock control, food safety, workplace health and safety, and hospitality compliance requirements.
Hardworking, positive attitude, and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Flexibility to work weekdays, weekends and public holidays as required.

Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.

Salary: $79,500
